description_target.target_text: V-branch: each green rect spawns copies at (r+k*h, c+-k*w) down-left and down-right, clipped to grid

racket_target.raw_code:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let ((h (rows g)) (w (cols g)))
    (let ((corners
      (filter (lambda (x) x)
        (flatmap (lambda (r)
          (map (lambda (c)
            (if (and (= (cell-at g r c) 3)
                     (or (= r 0) (not (= (cell-at g (- r 1) c) 3)))
                     (or (= c 0) (not (= (cell-at g r (- c 1)) 3))))
              (let ((rh (let loop ((rr 1))
                      (if (and (< (+ r rr) h) (= (cell-at g (+ r rr) c) 3))
                        (loop (+ rr 1)) rr)))
                    (rw (let loop ((cc 1))
                      (if (and (< (+ c cc) w) (= (cell-at g r (+ c cc)) 3))
                        (loop (+ cc 1)) cc))))
                (list r c rh rw))
              #f))
          (range 0 w)))
        (range 0 h)))))
      (grid-from-fn h w (lambda (r c)
        (if (or (= (cell-at g r c) 3)
                (let loop ((rs corners))
                  (if (null? rs) #f
                    (let ((rect (first rs)))
                      (let ((r0 (first rect)) (c0 (second rect))
                            (rh (third rect)) (rw (fourth rect)))
                        (if (>= (- r r0) rh)
                          (let ((k (quotient (- r r0) rh)))
                            (let ((row-in-block (modulo (- r r0) rh)))
                              (if (or
                                    (let ((nc (- c0 (* k rw))))
                                      (and (>= c nc) (< c (+ nc rw))))
                                    (let ((nc (+ c0 (* k rw))))
                                      (and (>= c nc) (< c (+ nc rw)))))
                                #t
                                (loop (rest rs)))))
                          (loop (rest rs))))))))
          3 0)))))))
